description: This file defines a REST controller for handling ride-related HTTP requests in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints for creating a ride, retrieving a ride by ID, fetching all rides, and retrieving rides associated with a specific user.

classes.name: RideController
classes.description: REST controller handling ride operations such as creation, retrieval by ID, listing all rides, and listing rides for a specific user.

methods.name: createRide
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new ride using RideCreateRequest data.

methods.name: getRide
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific ride by its ID.

methods.name: getAllRides
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all rides.

methods.name: getRidesByUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all rides associated with a specific user ID.
